blocks.text: Annieville Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Annieville is the riverfront end of North Delta: River Road runs along the Fraser River through its industrial strips and the Annieville houses, then meets Nordel Way for Highway 91 access.
112 Street is the neighbourhood spine: Annieville Elementary is at 9240 112 Street and Annieville Lions Park is at 9150 112 Street, a few doors apart.
River Road at Centre Street is gated to general traffic: City material says the gate allows bus, emergency vehicle, bike and pedestrian traffic only, so through-drivers use Nordel Way.

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Annieville houses sit below the River Road industrial frontage, in the oldest part of North Delta, with the park and school cluster on 112 Street as the residential core.

Delta's Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw No. 8400, 2024 maps North Delta growth mainly to the Scott Road Corridor and the Nordel Social Heart, leaving Annieville's house streets outside the named growth corridors.
The OCP land use map shows River Road and Derwent Way industrial land wrapping the north side of the Annieville houses, so house lots can back onto employment land.

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The River Road gate shapes daily life: residents heading to the Alex Fraser Bridge, Highway 91 or Tilbury must use Nordel Way, because River Road at Centre Street is closed to general traffic.
Delta's OCP includes a Riverside Development Permit Area (Map IID), so riverfront-adjacent work in North Delta can need a development permit on top of zoning.
School placement is by catchment, not by street name: School District No. 37 (Delta), called SD37, tells new families to verify their catchment school through the School Locator or the board office.

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Annieville Lions Park has been a North Delta gathering place for generations and was built through the efforts of local residents, per the City's master plan page.
The park's water park runs from the Victoria Day weekend in May to the Labour Day weekend in September, with water on between 10 a.m. and 9 p.m.
A large picnic shelter in Annieville Lions Park can be reserved online through the City, with a reservation fee.
Home Quest, a Provincial Online School, is based at 9240 112 Street inside Annieville Elementary, so the building serves more than its catchment.
The master plan adds an accessible overlook deck with views of Bob Bunnett Field, naming the ball field most house buyers would not know from the street.

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Status: final plan approved December 8, 2025; detailed design, then construction planned fall 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The park rebuild is already funded in City planning: Delta's 2026 Financial Plan includes $7 million for the Annieville Lions Park project, per the City's December 2025 release.

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: getting around

items.t: Nordel Way is the commuter route: City material directs Annieville drivers bound for the Alex Fraser Bridge, Highway 91 or Tilbury Park to Nordel Way because of the River Road gate.
River Road still works for local trips on foot or bike: the Centre Street gate passes pedestrians and cyclists, so the riverfront stays reachable without a car.
The South Fraser Perimeter Road (Highway 17) is the reason River Road changed: the City record ties the gate decision to regional traffic moving to that freeway when it opened.

blocks.text: Annieville Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check which side of the Centre Street gate a house sits on before assuming a River Road commute; the wrong side adds a Nordel Way loop to every bridge trip.
Check the OCP Riverside Development Permit Area map (Map IID) for any lot near the river before planning an addition or rebuild.

blocks.text: Annieville home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

48 houses sold in Annieville with a median price of $1,136,000 (the middle half sold between $1,050,000 and $1,298,750), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 95.1% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $517 per square foot, a median year built of 1970 and a median lot of 6,714 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Annieville?
faq.a: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board counted 46 houses listed in Annieville at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.

faq.q: Is Annieville a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: With a sales ratio of 17% in October 2026, houses in Annieville sat in a balanced market. The reports read under 12% as a buyers’ market and over 20% as a sellers’ market.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Annieville from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 25 houses sold in Annieville; North Delta as a whole recorded 154.

faq.q: What did houses in Annieville sell for?
faq.a: 48 houses sold in Annieville from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $1,136,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Annieville?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.1% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
